topics.title: 144-Hour Visa-Free Transit in China: Who Qualifies

facts.period: maximum stay under the visa-free transit policy
facts.source: National Immigration Administration, visa-free transit policy (过境免签政策)
facts.note: the stay window, not a fee. 144 hours is six days.

facts.period: the same window expressed in days
facts.source: National Immigration Administration, visa-free transit policy (过境免签政策)

facts.period: the onward destination the traveller must already hold a ticket for
facts.source: National Immigration Administration, visa-free transit policy
facts.note: the traveller cannot return to the country they came from; the itinerary must be A -> China -> C

mustSay: This is a transit policy, not a tourist visa: the traveller must be passing through to a third country.
The stay is limited to the region covered by the entry port, not to China as a whole.
It cannot be extended and it is not a work or study permission.
Travellers should confirm the current eligible ports and nationalities with the National Immigration Administration before booking, because both lists change.
avoid: Do not state an eligible-country count, a port count, or any fee.
Do not describe it as a visa.
Do not give a list of ports from memory.

topics.why: The 183-day threshold is safe to state, but the six-year rule and the treaty tie-breakers need the exact wording of the announcement before a number goes on the page.
Visa fees are set per nationality by reciprocity. Without the current schedule for each nationality this page would have to publish a fee it cannot cite.
The overstay penalty is a specific article of the Exit and Entry Administration Law and must be quoted from the text, not paraphrased.
Contribution rates differ by city and by year. A monthly figure without a city and a contribution year would be wrong somewhere.
The anchor piece. It composes the visa, tax, social-insurance and housing figures, so it cannot be written before those four exist.
No authority publishes this price. It needs three forwarder quotations taken on the same day, labelled as market quotations rather than official rates.
The residence-duration requirement and the test exemptions depend on the issuing country's agreement, which has to be checked per nationality.
